messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["donkey"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A slender brown equine shown in full side profile standing facing right, with a smooth tan-brown coat, paler underbelly and white around the muzzle, a long narrow head, two tall upright ears, a short dark upright mane along the neck, four long thin legs ending in single hooves, and a thin hanging tail tipped with a dark tuft of hair.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "long narrow equine head with brown fur and white around the nose and mouth", "part": "head", "where": "at the front end of the neck, facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "two tall upright pointed ears with brown outer fur and pale inner fur", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "dark eyes with a pale ring around", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the side of the head"}, {"looks_like": "pale whitish-grey muzzle with dark nostrils and mouth", "part": "muzzle", "where": "at the tip of the head"}, {"looks_like": "short dark brown stiff brush of hair", "part": "mane", "where": "along the top of the neck behind the ears"}, {"looks_like": "lean barrel-shaped brown body with lighter pale underbelly", "part": "torso", "where": "in the middle between the front and rear legs"}, {"looks_like": "four long slender brown legs with muscular upper parts and thin lower parts", "part": "legs", "where": "two under the front chest and two under the rear hips, extending to the ground"}, {"looks_like": "single rounded grey hooves", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom of each leg"}, {"looks_like": "thin brown tail ending in a long dark tuft of hair", "part": "tail", "where": "hanging down from the rear of the body"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
